title.zh: 活跃通勤（在指明人行道使用车辆的豁免——滨海湾）命令 2022
title.en: Active Mobility (Exemption for Use of Vehicle on Specified Footpath — Marina Bay) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Active Mobility (Exemption for Use of Vehicle on Specified Footpath — Marina Bay) Order 2022.
(2) [Deleted by S 707/2025 wef 15/11/2025]
[S 707/2025 wef 15/11/2025]

heading.en: Exemption for driving specified motor vehicle
Exemption for driving forklift, boom lift or scissor lift

text.en:
4. Section 16(1)(b) of the Act does not apply to an individual who drives a forklift, boom lift or scissor lift on a specified footpath under the following conditions:
(a)in the case of a forklift, the individual —
(i)is authorised by the Urban Redevelopment Authority to use the forklift to transport anything in connection with a specified event; and
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(ii)has attended and passed the Singapore Workforce Skills Qualifications (WSQ) — Operate Forklift Course;
(b)in the case of a boom lift, the individual —
(i)is authorised by the Urban Redevelopment Authority to use the boom lift to transport anything in connection with a specified event; and
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(ii)has attended and passed the Singapore Workforce Skills Qualifications (WSQ) — Operate Boom Lift Course;
(ba)in the case of a scissor lift, the —
(i)is authorised by the Urban Redevelopment Authority to use the scissor lift to transport anything in connection with a specified event; and
(ii)has attended and passed the Singapore Workforce Skills Qualifications (WSQ) — Operate Scissor Lift Course;
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(c)the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift is only used —
(i)in the case of a forklift — for the purpose referred to in sub‑paragraph (a)(i);
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(ii)in the case of a boom lift — for the purpose referred to in sub‑paragraph (b)(i); or
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(iii)in the case of a scissor lift — for the purpose referred to in sub paragraph (ba)(i);
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(d)the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift is lit in a manner that is visible to other users of the specified footpath from 7 p.m. to 7 a.m.;
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(e)the individual who drives the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift must drive at a speed not exceeding 10 km/h;
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(f)the individual who drives the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift must give way to other users of the specified footpath;
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(g)[Deleted by S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(h)there is in force, at any time the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift is used in connection with a specified event, a policy of insurance in relation to the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift insuring against any liability in respect of —
(i)the death of or bodily injury sustained by any person (other than the driver or any passenger of the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift); and
(ii)any property damage suffered by any person (other than the driver or any passenger of the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift),
caused by or arising out of the use of the forklift, boom lift or scissor lift;
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
(i)the risk under the policy of insurance mentioned in sub‑paragraph (g) is assumed by an insurer who, at the time of the issuance of the policy, is lawfully carrying on an insurance business in Singapore.
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
[S 738/2023 wef 15/11/2023]
